architecture_family: low-order ripple plus high-order parallel prefix
observations_used: ripple16 produced extremely low area and power but poor timing.
ripple8_prefix8 produced substantially better timing than ripple16 while retaining much of its area advantage.
At the 8/8 boundary, the prefix upper half was much smaller and lower-power than the carry-select upper half, at a moderate timing cost.
prefix16 reached the high-timing region but with substantially greater area than the ripple-prefix hybrid.
hypothesis: Varying the ripple-prefix boundary should trace a useful continuous area/timing tradeoff and may discover new Pareto-optimal hybrids.
